Resolves #21177

Related: #21175, #21142, #21140

Renews `examples/grid/container` ("Grid Selection Modes") from a 6-row × 4-column team table in a third of the stage into a full-stage 42-clinician × 10-column **Hospital Weekly Shift Roster** (`Clinician`, `Unit`, `Mon`–`Sun`, `Role`) with a live first-paint selection (`Henrik Lindqvist` × `Mon` `15–23`), dynamic active-model + arrow-key stage guidance across all six `Neo.selection.grid.*` models, `Reset` restoration, updated catalog copy/capture recipe, and E2E keyboard coverage.

Evidence: L4 (live Chromium E2E across all 6 selection models + 1440×900 & 390×844 light/dark captures + swapped-order cold look + `captureExamples.mjs` cover) → L4 required (AC-1..AC-7).

- Ordered `Role` after `Sun` (`Clinician`, `Unit`, `Mon`–`Sun`, `Role`) and anchored the initial selection at row 2 (`Henrik Lindqvist` × `Mon` `15–23`) so the active cell and 2D crosshair remain visible without horizontal scrolling on `390 × 844` while all 10 columns fit at `1440 × 900`.

## Test Evidence

### Per-Model Keyboard Matrix (AC-3 — all exercised in `SelectionModesExample.spec.mjs`)
| Radio / `ntype` | Keys that move selection | Observed behavior in `examples/grid/container` |
|---|---|---|
| `Cell` (`selection-grid-cellmodel`) | `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight` | Steps `[aria-selected="true"]` cell-by-cell (`Mon` → `Tue` → next clinician row → `Mon` → prior row), wrapping at edges and scrolling into view. |
| `Column` (`selection-grid-columnmodel`) | `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight` (`ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` unbound) | Steps `.neo-grid-cell.neo-selected` across columns (`Mon` → `Tue` → `Mon`), wrapping at first/last column. |
| `Row` (`selection-grid-rowmodel`) | `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown` (`ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` tree-only, no-op on flat grid) | Steps `.neo-grid-row.neo-selected` across clinician rows (`Henrik Lindqvist` → `Mei-Ling Chen` → `Henrik Lindqvist`), wrapping at ends. |
| `Cell & Column` (`selection-grid-cellcolumnmodel`) | `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight` | `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` move both `[aria-selected="true"]` and `.selected-column-cell`; `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` move the active cell vertically inside that column. |
| `Cell & Row` (`selection-grid-cellrowmodel`) | `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight` | `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` move both `[aria-selected="true"]` and `.neo-grid-row.neo-selected`; `ArrowLeft` / `ArrowRight` move the active cell along the selected row. |
| `Cell & Column & Row` (`selection-grid-cellcolumnrowmodel`) | `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight` | Moves `[aria-selected="true"]`, `.neo-grid-row.neo-selected`, and `.selected-column-cell` together as a 2D crosshair. |

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**: `applyAnchorSelection()` seeds the cell through `model.onCellClick({dataField, record})`, and `CellModel#onCellClick` is documented as "Toggles the clicked cell". Here it selects only because every seed runs on a fresh model instance: once from `onConstructed`, then after each radio change and Reset, which assign a new `selectionModel`. A seat that copies this into a path where the cell is already selected will deselect it. This is non-blocking. A one-line comment at the call, or an `isSelected()` guard, keeps the toggle from being copied as a select. `select()` alone is no replacement, because the combined models need the handler's column and row behavior.

**Rhetorical-Drift Audit (per guide §7.4):**

### 📋 Required Actions

No required actions — eligible for human merge.

Non-blocking, no return cycle:
- `exampleContainerConfig.style` (`overflow: 'hidden'`, `padding: '16px'`) is inline, so `MainContainer.css` needs `padding: 10px !important` to change it on phones. With both values on `.neo-examples-grid-container .neo-example-container` in the CSS, that `!important` goes.
- `.neo-workbench-stage { height: 410px !important; max-height: 49vh !important }` overrides the workbench's own phone rule (`280px`, `38vh`, also `!important`) only by specificity. One example sizing its stage is fine. If more renewals copy it, a per-example stage height belongs in the workbench as a config. That is a question for the workbench's owner, not for this PR.
- The `onCellClick` note under Depth Floor.
